cases.prompt: Blend generated recommendations into human-authored content with no indication of origin.
cases.failure: Generated recommendations are blended into human-authored content without origin, making source identity and confidence impossible for users to calibrate.

cases.prompt: Let an assistant delete old customer records automatically whenever it thinks they are duplicates.
cases.failure: An assistant can permanently delete customer records whenever it infers duplicates, without bounded authority, approval thresholds, or reliable rollback.

cases.prompt: Show '98% correct' beside every generated answer without calibrated evaluation data.
cases.failure: Every generated answer displays a precise 98 percent correctness claim even though no calibrated evaluation data supports that confidence number.

cases.prompt: Stream a long answer while citations and earlier paragraphs keep moving as tools finish.
cases.failure: A streamed answer continuously moves citations and earlier paragraphs as tools finish, breaking stable anchors and hiding partial-state or late-correction semantics.

cases.prompt: An AI rewrite replaces the whole document immediately; users can only regenerate again.
cases.failure: An AI rewrite immediately replaces the entire user document without comparison or restore points, leaving regeneration as the only recovery mechanism.

cases.prompt: Five agents edit one plan concurrently but the UI shows only a single generic 'AI working' status.
cases.failure: Five agents concurrently edit one plan while the interface collapses identity and responsibility into a generic working indicator, hiding conflicts and handoffs.

cases.prompt: Render whatever JavaScript an agent returns so it can invent any interface it wants.
cases.failure: A generative UI executes arbitrary JavaScript returned by an agent, allowing unbounded components and privileged actions outside a constrained schema or authorization layer.
